days_detail.title: SINGAPORE - INCHEON - GYEONGGIDO - SEOUL (Lunch)
days_detail.desc: Embark on your flight journey to Incheon. Upon arrival, visit Inspire Resort , where you’ll be amazed by a spectacular 3D LED show . Then, cruise the coastline at Wolmido and feed seagulls on a scenic boat ride . Hands on Gochujangmaking and Fruit Mochi before a tasty bibimbap lunch at Byeokkot Nongbu . Continue your adventure at Aegibong Peace Ecological Park , where you can learn about Korea’s history and enjoy panoramic views from the observatory. Wrap up your day at Laveniche March Avenue Golden Waterway , a picturesque waterway known as the “Venice of Korea,” perfect for a relaxing stroll or some shopping before heading to Seoul to rest.

days_detail.title: SEOUL - GYEONGGIDO - SEOUL (Breakfast, Lunch)
days_detail.desc: Discover Ganghwa’s charm with a visit to the historic Ganghwa Cathedral , followed by a unique stop at Joyang Textile Café for a refreshing drink in a retro setting. Continue to Geumpung Brewery for an authentic makgeolli-making experience before the thrill of Ganghwa Luge, offering fun and scenic rides. Wrap up the day with shopping at the Premium Outlet , where you can find great deals and stylish brands.

days_detail.title: SEOUL (Breakfast, Lunch)
days_detail.desc: Discover the best of Seoul with a visit to the Ginseng Experience Centre , where you can shop for premium products. Enjoy duty-free Korean cosmetics shopping , then explore the historic Gyeongbokgung Palace and try a fun Hanbok experience . End your day in trendy Seongsu-dong , enjoying its cafés and boutiques, and stop by HAUS NOWHERE , a cutting-edge concept space where shopping, art, and immersive experiences come together.

days_detail.desc_cn:

 ·松岛海上缆车 - 搭乘缆车，可以将 釜山松岛一带的美丽风光尽收眼底。 
 ·BIFF广场 - 可以找寻BIFF获奖人手 掌、脚印的铜盘和获奖作品名字的 铜盘被镶在广场的地面上。小摊上 的小吃也是绝对不可以错过的，比 如辣炒年糕、紫菜包饭、鱼饼串、 鱿鱼干、水果、鲷鱼烧、炒栗子等 等。

days_detail.title_cn: 釜山 (早餐, 午餐, 晚餐)
days_detail.desc: Begin at the stunning Arte Museum , where immersive digital exhibitions ignite your imagination. Then hop on the Haeundae Beach Train for a scenic coastal ride to the Cheongsapo Daritdol Observatory , offering breathtaking ocean views from its glass-floored skywalk. Unwind at Club D Oasis , where you can choose between the thrills of a water park or the soothing comfort of a traditional Korean jjimjilbang . End your day at the lively Gwangalli Beach , with its golden sands and dazzling night views of the Gwangan Bridge.
days_detail.desc_cn:
·海东龙宫寺 - 位于海边的寺庙，站 在岩石上可以聆听到海浪拍打岩壁 的声音，欣赏日出的壮观美景。


 ·海云台Blue Line Park海滨列车 - 电车座位皆面海，沿途湛蓝的海色填满整个车窗。


 ·青沙浦踏石展望台 - 釜山海云台地区超受欢迎的海上展望台。


 ·新世界Centum City温泉乐园 -有22个温泉浴池和13个主题桑拿房 和汗蒸房，并且还有室外的足浴池 等其他洗浴设施。


 ·The Bay 101–釜山夜景

days_detail.title: BUSAN - POHANG - GYEONGJU (BREAKFAST, LUNCH, DINNER)
days_detail.title_cn: 釜山 - 蔚山 - 庆州 (早餐, 午餐, 晚餐)
days_detail.desc: Stroll through Guryongpo Park , a serene coastal retreat offering sweeping ocean views, then travel back in time at Japanese House Street , where preserved colonial-era homes tell stories of Korea’s modern past. Head to Hwanho Park to experience the striking Space Walk , a unique steel walkway offering panoramic views. Continue to the Igari Anchor Observatory , where dramatic cliffside views and crystal-clear waters create the perfect photo spot. Then make your way to Gyeongju Donggung Palace and Wolji Pond to glimpse into Silla-era elegance, with restored pavilions reflected on calm waters. End your day with a peaceful evening walk across the beautifully illuminated Woljeongyo Bridge.
days_detail.desc_cn:
·鲸鱼传统文化村


 ·庆州佛国寺(世界文化遗产)- 一座以花岗岩石基为布局配以石桥石塔及木制建筑群的寺庙华丽宏伟。


 ·瞻星台 - 朝鲜半岛最古老的天文建筑物，也是目前亚洲现存最古老的观象台。


 ·庆州大陵苑 - 是规模最大、最密集的新罗时期王陵公园最密集的新罗时 期王陵公园，面积广达十二万坪，公 园内有23个隆起的巨大古坟。


 ·月精桥 - 建于新罗时期，是王宫 “月城”的出入口，但因遭遇战火 烧毁，仅剩下零星的桥墩石块，直 到近年来才进行复原重建工程，将 古色古香、壮观气派的月精桥，展 示给世人观赏。

Then, journey to Jincheon to cross the ancient stone Nongdari Bridge , one of Korea’s oldest, and feel the thrill of walking the sky-high Mir 309 Suspension Bridge , offering sweeping views of nature.

Discover Korea’s wellness at a premium Ginseng showroom , followed by a visit to a Cosmetic shop to explore the latest K-beauty trends. Wander through the charming alleys of Ikseongdong Hanok Village , filled with stylish cafés and boutiques. Then end your day shopping and sightseeing in the lively streets of Myeongdong, Seoul’s ultimate fashion and beauty hotspot.

days_detail.title: BUSAN (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
days_detail.desc:
After breakfast, proceed to enjoy a ride on Haeundae Beach Train where you can admire the picturesque views of Haeundae. 

At Cheongsapo Daritdol Observatory , walk out on the glass-floored observatory, 20m above the ocean with a view of the unique beauty of the mainland’s coastal areas. As night falls, get ready for a stunning visual feast at Gwangalli Beach for the Busan Fireworks Festival , a spectacular showcase featuring special fireworks display, state- of-the-art laser lightings and music that will get your hearts racing.

days_detail.title: BUSAN - ULSAN - GYEONGJU (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
days_detail.desc:
This morning, visit FE01 Upcycled Cultural Space , where industrial waste transforms into a vibrant hub of art, culture, and sustainabilityperfect for eco-conscious travelers! Then, travel to ancient kingdom of Shilla - Gyeongju to visit UNESCO site Bulguksa Temple for the stunning ancient architecture and tranquil landscapes. Thereafter, proceed down to Daereungwon Tomb Complex for the amazing sight of the royal burial mounds and one of the oldest existing astronomical Cheomseongdae Observatory . End the day with a visit to bustling street Hwangridan Street where the traditional architecture revamp into shops, cafes, and restaurants.



 *If time permit, may stopover Starbuck Cafe for photo stop.

days_detail.title: GYEONGJU - DAEGU - GYEONGGI-DO - SEOUL (Breakfast, Lunch, Dinner)
days_detail.desc: Today, travel to Daegu city and access on a scenic cable car ride in Palgongsan , where you can soak in panoramic views of the mountains and cityscape, creating a truly memorable and unique experience. Thereafter, proceed to Premium Outlet for some shopping time before heading Seoul for your overnight stay.

days_detail.title: SEOUL (Breakfast, Lunch)
days_detail.desc:
Kick-off the day with a visit the most iconic Gyeongbokgung Palace , the first royal palace built in the Joseon Dynasty and the serene, peaceful and beautiful palace worth visiting for all seasons. You may get to try on Traditional Korean Hanbok . 

Continue on to Ikseongdong Hanok Village , a trendy hanok street of cafés, restaurants with unique concepts and designs 

operated by young artists and entrepreneurs. En-route, make a stop at Ginseng Gallery and Cosmetic Shop for a spot of 

shopping. Then, visit traditional Gwangjang Market . Food lover can find forest of small stalls selling street food and traditional Korean food. For the adventurous may consider trying sannakji (live octopus sashimi) with tentacles still wriggle on plate. End the day with Myeongdong shopping street.

days_detail.title_cn: 首尔 （早餐，午餐）
days_detail.desc: Kick-off the day with a visit to Seoul’s hidden spot Ikseongdong Hanok Village , streets of traditional hanok buildings in the form of cafés, restaurants, and handicraft shops with unique design. En-route, make a stop at a Ginseng Gallery and Cosmetic Shop for a spot of shopping. Next, proceed to Namsan Seoul Tower for panoramic view of downtown Seoul. You may wish to get a lock as a symbol of everlasting bond and leave it at Locks of Love. Afterward, head over to the bustling Myeongdong shopping , where you can fashionable clothing at affordable prices and indulge in delectable snacks from the street vendors.
days_detail.desc_cn: 今天，探索益善洞韩屋村，融合传统 韩屋建筑和现代风格的咖啡馆、餐厅 、手工艺店，呈现独特的文化风情。 途中停留一下人参店和化妝品店逛逛 。随后参观广藏市场。美食爱好者将 会被众多小摊位所吸引，提供各种街头 食品和传统韩国美食。接着，前往南 山塔，乘坐缆车欣赏首尔市中心的全 景。之后，在明洞购物区，购物時尚服 飾，同時品尝街头摊贩的美味小吃。

days_detail.title_cn: 首尔 - 新加坡 （早餐 ）
days_detail.desc: After breakfast, drop by Healthy Liver showroom for a look at its renowned healthy products. After that, transfer to Incheon International Airport for your flight back to Singapore.

早餐后前往健康肝展厅享受一些购物 乐趣。之后前往仁川机场飞回新加坡。

days_detail.title_cn: 新加坡 - 仁川
days_detail.desc: Assemble at the airport for your flight to Incheon.
days_detail.desc_cn: 在机场集合，乘坐航班前往仁川。

attractions_detail.name_cn: 仁川中华街·炸酱面博物馆

days_detail.title: INCHEON - GYEONGGIDO (LUNCH, DINNER)
days_detail.title_cn: 仁川 - 京畿道 (午餐, 晚餐)
days_detail.desc: Upon arrival, meet your guide and proceed to the Incheon Open Port Cultural District. Enjoy a comfortable Electric Buggy ride to the photo-worthy street murals of Songwoldong Fairytale Village, then continue to Chinatown to explore its vibrant painted streets and visit the Jjajangmyeon Museum to discover the origins of this beloved Chinese-Korean dish. Next, visit the Jemulpo Club , known for its elegant Western-style architecture and historical displays, before heading to the Hyundai Premium Outlet for shopping and concluding the day with a fun Kyochon Chicken DIY experience .
days_detail.desc_cn: 抵达后，前往仁川开港文化区乘坐电 瓶车前往松月洞童話村壁画街道。接 着在中华街欣赏色彩斑斓的建筑和充 满各种绘画插图，参观炸酱面博物馆 了解中韓美食历史，随后在清朝和日 本租界区分界阶梯处停下留照。之后 前往京畿道。在稻花农场可沉浸在制 作韩国辣椒酱的体验中，还可以带回 国。结束一天的行程，前往现代折扣 购物中心。

days_detail.title: GYEONGGIDO (BREAKFAST, LUNCH)
days_detail.title_cn: 京畿道 (早餐, 午餐)
days_detail.desc: This morning, start your day by visiting the picturesque Gapyeong Sheep Farm & Café , where you'll have the chance to interact with friendly sheep amidst a charming countryside backdrop. Take a moment to relax in the cozy on-site café, savoring a refreshing drink . Afterwards, head over to Petite France , a french-themed cultural village features charming pastel-coloured buildings and beautiful scenery of mountains and a lake. Journey to Everland , Korea's largest theme park, featuring one of the world's steepest and fastest wooden rollercoasters.
days_detail.desc_cn: 今早开始您的一天，前往风景如画的 加平郡羊农场，您将有机会与友好的 羊互动，在舒适的咖啡馆品尝一杯清 爽的饮料。在小法国村，以法国文化 为主题的旅游胜地，包括仿法国建筑 、法国文学作品中的雕塑和展览。随 后，前往爱宝乐园，韩国最大的主题 公园，拥有世界上最陡峭、 最快的木 制过山车。

days_detail.title: GYEONGGIDO - SEOUL (BREAKFAST, LUNCH)
days_detail.title_cn: 京畿道 - 首尔 (早餐, 晚餐)
days_detail.desc: After breakfast, travel to Seoul city and visit the most iconic Gyeongbokgung Palace , the majestic first royal palace of the Joseon Dynasty, dress in Traditional Hanbok wear . This serene and beautiful palace is a must-visit, offering its enchanting charm in every season. En-route, make a stop at a Ginseng Gallery and Cosmetic Shop for a spot of shopping before heading to Dongdaemun for some shopping time. Conclude the day with a visit to traditional Mangwon Market . Food lover can find forest of small stalls selling street food and traditional Korean food..
days_detail.desc_cn: 早餐后，前往首尔市参观最具代表性的 景福宫，这是朝鲜王朝的第一座雄伟皇 宫，穿着传统韩服。这座宁静而美丽的 宫殿是一处必游之地，每个季节都展现 着迷人的魅力。途中，可以看到青瓦 台，即韩国总统府。然后，在人参和化 妆品商店停留一下，体验购物的乐趣 。 之后前往迷人的北村韩屋村，现在是许 多艺术画廊、传统工坊和餐馆的所在 ， 也坐落在居民家园之间。结束这一天的 行程，参观广藏市场。美食爱好者可以 在这里找到一片小摊的海洋，售卖着各 种街头食品和传统的韩国美食。对于寻 求冒险的人，也许可以尝试生炸章鱼刺 身，观看触角在盘子上仍然蠕动的奇特经验。

days_detail.title: SEOUL (BREAKFAST, LUNCH)
days_detail.title_cn: 首尔 (早餐, 午餐)
days_detail.desc: This morning, proceed to Namsan Tower for panoramic view of downtown Seoul. You may wish to get a lock as a symbol of everlasting bond and leave it at Locks of Love. Then, make a stop at a Healthy Liver Gallery before visiting Ikseondong Hanok Village , a neighbourhood gem of Hanok that offers trendy cafes, bars, and restaurants, decorated under the 1920s, vintage theme. Lastly, enjoy some time at Myeongdong district, a bustling hub where you can shop to your heart's content.
days_detail.desc_cn: 今天早上，前往南山塔，欣赏首尔市 区的全景。接着，参观益肝店，再游 览益善洞韩屋村。这里是传统韩屋小 巷和现代与传统结合的韩式古建筑, 浓 厚的文化氛围和吸引游客的独特魅力 而著名。最后，在东大门区度过一些 时光，这是一个繁华的中心，您可以 在夜晚深入夜市尽情购物。
